meta.title: Tax Credit Transfer and Syndication Pricing Watchlist
meta.methodology: Prices are dollars paid per $1.00 of federal tax credit face value. Verified ranges are recorded only where a fetchable public source stated the range; otherwise the price fields remain null with status VERIFY.

markets.label: Transferable clean-energy credits
markets.source_note: Crux 2026 Mid-Year Market Intelligence Report (published 2026-09-09): "Market-wide average pricing declined to $0.913 for 2026 ITCs and $0.930 for PTCs, below typical historical ranges of $0.920–0.925 for ITCs and $0.940–0.950 for PTCs." The low and high are those two averages, not a traded range. The guide previously cited for $0.90–$0.95 no longer states that range.

markets.label: Investment-grade ITC transfers
markets.source_note: Crux 2026 guide summarizes 2025 investment-grade ITC pricing range.

markets.label: Investment-grade PTC transfers
markets.source_note: Crux 2026 guide summarizes 2025 investment-grade PTC pricing range.

markets.label: New Markets Tax Credit equity pricing
markets.source_note: Official CDFI Fund program page verifies the program but does not publish current cents-per-credit market pricing. Leave pricing null until a fetchable pricing source is read. Re-checked 2026-10-09: the CDFI Fund page states no price; one Area Development worked example (Q3 2026) assumes about $0.79, which is an illustration, not a market range.

markets.label: Federal Historic Tax Credit syndication pricing
markets.source_note: Official NPS tax incentives page verifies the federal HTC program but does not publish current cents-per-credit market pricing. Leave pricing null until a fetchable pricing source is read. Re-checked 2026-10-09: the NPS page states no price, and the Novogradac pages that discuss HTC pricing block scripted reads.
